feature_name: Add LICENSE symlinks to crate directories
description: Create symbolic links from each crate directory to the root LICENSE file to ensure each crate includes proper licensing when published. This follows established patterns used by other Rust projects like clap-rs. The ratatui-macros crate already has its own LICENSE file with different copyright holders, so it should be left unchanged.
functional_requirements: Create a symlink named LICENSE in each crate directory (ratatui-core, ratatui-crossterm, ratatui-termion, ratatui-termwiz, ratatui-widgets, ratatui) that points to the root LICENSE file
Ensure the symlinks use relative paths so they work correctly in the repository structure
Do not modify the existing ratatui-macros/LICENSE file since it has different copyright information
Verify that the symlinks are created correctly and will be included when each crate is packaged for publication
